name: Nasuverse
overview: a connected multiverse of urban fantasy stories created by Japanese writer Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi under the company Type-Moon. It includes major works like Fate/stay night, Tsukihime, and The Garden of Sinners (Kara no Kyoukai), all sharing deep lore, rules of magic, and parallel timelines.
